name: Inktrons #0169
description: Built for the opening bell. Inktrons #0169 is a Legendary Quadwall Prime, a four-screen monitor wall with a trading console, finished in Royal Ink. Its screens stream HOOD (Robinhood) with mirrored depth bars pulsing on both sides of the book alongside auction clock, heatmap, candle chart, worked by flip toggles and a spinning dial. It comes with an ink drop on top, an ink bottle at its side and a paper bin in the corner. Set on a Checker platform against a twinkling starfield. ERC404 on Ink, one of 180.
